## 主张 Claim

原有理市场模型的每个物理初态只要维护份额为正，在实际 β=0 纠正下都存在有限 N；初始支持达到含额外耗用的 K_N 时，全部纠正步骤真实执行，实际到达状态在撤除干预后满足原 β=1/2 的永久保护证书。 / Every physical state of the original rational market model with positive renewal share has a finite beta=0 correction horizon N. Initial support above K_N, including extra per-step consumption, makes every pulse step executable and lets the actual arrived state satisfy the original beta=1/2 perpetual protection certificate after withdrawal.

Canonical source: [RegimeTransition.lean](../../../../experiments/market-generativity/formal/RegimeTransition.lean)

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 原 x,q,w 更新律及 x,q,w∈[0,1]、x>0；纠正阶段真实 β=0，其他参数保持原例，随后 β=1/2。 / Original x,q,w update law, x,q,w in [0,1], x>0; beta=0 actually holds during the pulse with other example parameters retained, followed by beta=1/2.
- 每步额外支持耗用 κ≥0；C₀≥K_N，K₀=5、Kₙ₊₁=(10/9)(Kₙ+1+κ)；原货币预算先付后收入，没有其他冲击。 / Extra support consumption kappa>=0 per pulse step; C0>=K_N with K0=5 and K(n+1)=(10/9)(K(n)+1+kappa); original monetary funding remains paid before receipts, with no other shocks.

干预是共同运行关系中的有效改变，形成、授权与具体实施尚为给定对应；κ 只覆盖指定支持单位，不是全部生活和制度代价的统一尺度。 / Intervention is an effective change in shared operating relations; its formation, authority and implementation remain supplied correspondence. Kappa covers designated support units, not a common scale for every living and institutional cost.
